title: Figures 4-5: Comparing numeric vs CLT probability density functions of N and Y = ln(N)
description: Two plots. 'Figure 4' ('PROBABILITY DENSITY FUNCTION OF N') compares the purely numeric result (thick curve) with the CLT lognormal approximation (thin curve) for N = Number of ET Civilizations in Galaxy (0-4000). 'Figure 5' ('PROBABILITY DENSITY FUNCTION OF Y=ln(N)') compares the numeric result with the normal (Gaussian) approximation over Y = ln(N) from 0 to 12. Below begins section '8. Distance of the Nearest Extraterrestrial Civilization as a Probability Distribution'.
